items.statement: The investigation explicitly distinguishes S0, S1 and T1 surfaces and validates stationary-point character.
items.expected: Reports state-specific calculations and frequency or justified equivalent classification.

items.statement: The S1/T1 access step is quantitatively characterized.
items.expected: Reports a crossing search or justified alternative, identifies the S1/T1 state pair, and gives its energy relative to the S1 minimum when available.

items.statement: Each claimed cleavage transition structure is connected to the intended reactant and product endpoints.
items.expected: IRC, endpoint following, relaxed scan, or justified equivalent connectivity evidence is supplied for both channels.

items.statement: The two triplet C–N cleavage channels have distinct low free-energy barriers.
items.expected: Two channel barriers are reported and compared quantitatively in kcal/mol relative to 2A(S0), without relying on an undisclosed channel ordering.

items.statement: Formation of 4 and CO2 radical-anion potassium ion pair is strongly exergonic.
items.expected: The overall solvent Gibbs reaction energy is reported with sign and reference convention.
